title: Test security
safetyNote: Nothing in production will be modified. SequrAI only runs safe simulations.

emptyState.headline: Test security on your deployment blockers
emptyState.description: SequrAI reproduces each issue safely so you can confirm it before fixing.

needs_review.headline: Is your application ready for production?
needs_review.description: Start with a Production Review of your latest code.

preparing.headline: Scanning code…
preparing.description: SequrAI is scanning your repository to build your Production Verdict.
preparing.waitMessage: Reading architecture, dependencies, and security patterns…

ready.headline: Your Production Verdict is ready
ready.description: Review your deployment blockers and test security on the ones that matter most.

running.headline: Testing security…
running.description: SequrAI is safely reproducing the issue to collect Evidence.
running.waitMessage: Checking authentication… testing authorization… testing session isolation…

issues_found.headline: Issue confirmed
issues_found.description: SequrAI reproduced the problem. Review the evidence before applying a fix.

fix_ready.headline: Ready to fix with AI
fix_ready.description: Apply the AI fix, then test security again to confirm the issue is closed.

protected.headline: Ready for production
protected.description: Security test complete. The issue no longer reproduces.

completed_clean.headline: Ready for production
completed_clean.description: No issues reproduced during the security test. Your application looks safe to deploy.

customize.title: Customize your test
customize.reviewFirst: Review your code first, then you can test your application.

errors.startFailed: Could not start the security test.
errors.invalidAnalysisRun: That analysis run does not belong to this project.
errors.notEnabled: Security testing is not enabled for this project.
errors.needsReviewFirst: Scan your code first so SequrAI knows which version to test.
errors.mapFailed: Could not map selected tests to attack scenarios.

idor-cross-tenant.title: Can someone access another user's data?
idor-cross-tenant.description: Checks whether one account can read or change another account's records.

unauthenticated-endpoint.title: Can protected pages be opened without logging in?
unauthenticated-endpoint.description: Tests whether sensitive routes accept requests without authentication.

webhook-signature-bypass.title: Can fake webhook events be accepted?
webhook-signature-bypass.description: Simulates webhook calls with missing or invalid signatures.

idempotency-replay.title: Can the same action charge or mutate data twice?
idempotency-replay.description: Sends the same request twice to detect duplicate side effects.

double-credit-consumption.title: Can credits or quotas be spent more than once?
double-credit-consumption.description: Attempts repeated consumption of the same balance.

workflow-bypass.title: Can a checkout or approval step be skipped?
workflow-bypass.description: Tries to jump past required workflow states.

rag-prompt-injection.title: Can uploaded content hijack AI answers?
rag-prompt-injection.description: Uses safe mock documents to test retrieval-time manipulation.

unauthorized-tool-invocation.title: Can the AI call tools it should not use?
unauthorized-tool-invocation.description: Simulates tool calls outside the allowed profile.

memory-isolation.title: Can one user read another user's AI memory?
memory-isolation.description: Checks whether memory retrieval crosses user boundaries.

rag-poisoning.title: Can poisoned documents change AI behavior?
rag-poisoning.description: Observes how the app handles untrusted retrieved content.
